title: SEO Marketing & Social Media Executive
description:
Hiring: SEO Marketing & Social Media Executive Company: Velnik India Ltd.
 Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
 Department: Digital Marketing
 Industry: FMCG / Cosmetics & Personal Care Job Description: We are looking for a creative and result-oriented SEO Marketing & Social Media Executive to manage our digital presence, improve search engine visibility, and handle social media activities. Key Responsibilities: Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve website ranking and organic traffic. Conduct keyword research, on-page SEO and off-page SEO activities. Manage and optimize Google Search Console & Google Analytics . Create, manage and schedule content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and other social media platforms . Develop engaging social media posts, captions, reels and campaigns. Monitor social media performance and prepare regular reports. Track website traffic, keyword rankings and digital marketing performance. Perform competitor analysis and identify new digital marketing opportunities. Coordinate with the creative/content team for digital campaigns. Stay updated with the latest SEO, social media and digital marketing trends . Candidate Requirements: Experience in SEO, Digital Marketing and Social Media Management . Good knowledge of On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Keyword Research and Link Building . Knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Search Console . Good understanding of social media platforms and content marketing. Good communication and creative skills. Candidates from FMCG / Cosmetics / Personal Care industry will be preferred. Experience: 14 Years
 Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
 Employment Type: Full Time Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV. CONTACT NO.- 6262626304

Key Skills: SEO,On Page Optimiztion,Off Page SEO,Google Analytics,Social Media,Content Marketing,Link Building,Keyword Research
